subject: High School Feasibility Study Planning
overview: The Finance Subcommittee discussed potential city locations for a new high school and reviewed the budget and procurement process for the upcoming feasibility study.

items.title: Potential High School Sites
items.summary: The subcommittee and city staff discussed the pros and cons of several potential locations for the high school, including the current campus, Playstead Park, Tufts Park, and the Andrews Middle School site.

items.title: Feasibility Study Budget and Procurement
items.summary: The subcommittee reviewed a projected $2.25 million to $3 million budget for the feasibility study and discussed obtaining procurement templates from neighboring communities.
